```{python}
import mlflow
import config
config.setup()

experiment_name = "NACE2025_DATASET"
number_of_runs = 18

mlflow.set_tracking_uri(os.getenv("MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI"))
mlflow.set_experiment(experiment_name)


# Get the experiment ID
experiment = mlflow.get_experiment_by_name(experiment_name)
if experiment is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Experiment '{experiment_name}' not found")

experiment_id = experiment.experiment_id

# Fetch the last runs
runs = mlflow.search_runs(
    experiment_ids=[experiment_id],
    max_results=number_of_runs,
    order_by=["start_time DESC"]
)
```

```{python}
import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
runs
```


```{python}
import plotly.express as px

# Préparer les données pour la visualisation
df = runs[['params.top_k', 'params.LLM_MODEL', 'params.COLLECTION_NAME', 'metrics.accuracy_overall_lvl_5']].copy()
df['metrics.accuracy_overall_lvl_5'] = df['metrics.accuracy_overall_lvl_5'].astype(float)

# Créer un graphique pour chaque valeur unique de top_k
for top_k in df['params.top_k'].unique():
    subset = df[df['params.top_k'] == top_k]

    # Créer le graphique à barres groupées avec Plotly
    fig = px.bar(
        subset,
        x='params.LLM_MODEL',
        y='metrics.accuracy_overall_lvl_5',
        color='params.COLLECTION_NAME',
        barmode='group',
        title=f'Accuracy by LLM Model and Collection Name (top_k={top_k})',
        labels={'params.LLM_MODEL': 'LLM Model', 'metrics.accuracy_overall_lvl_5': 'Accuracy (Level 5)', 'params.COLLECTION_NAME': 'Collection Name'}
    )

    # Ajouter les valeurs sur les barres
    fig.update_traces(
        texttemplate='%{y:.2f}',
        textposition='inside',
    )

    # Personnaliser la mise en page
    fig.update_layout(
        xaxis_title='LLM Model',
        yaxis_title='Accuracy (Level 5)',
        legend_title='Collection Name',
        xaxis_tickangle=-45,
        uniformtext_minsize=8,
        uniformtext_mode='hide',
        paper_bgcolor='white',
        plot_bgcolor='white',
    )

    # Afficher le graphique
    fig.show()

```
